inputs._note: gull = cubic Bezier from vertex (0,0) via c1, c2 to tip, right wing, y up (brand/gull_logo.py); left wing = mirror in x

case._height: 19.3mm local deck; pose translation calibrates lowest front deck edge to19.3mm above desk on each half.
case._bottom_t: clear acrylic floor plate thickness beneath the stainless weight
case._wall_t: frost shell wall and lower skirt nominal thickness
case._lip_bottom_z: shell cavity ceiling; plate top 12.8 plus 1.5 mm leaf/pad clearance
case._bezel_min: Analytic minimum at a rounded bbox corner; straight-side bezel is case.plan.bezel_mm.
case._opening_clearance: top opening = outline edges pulled back to (bezel - clearance); i.e. ~1 mm around the pitch boxes
case._opening_inset: SUPERSEDED for the top frame by the stagger-hugging opening (blender/out/opening.json from outline.opening); kept only as a fallback
case._opening_r_min: min corner radius of the opening (CNC inner radius)
case._edge_fillet: shared softened edge radius on both halves for consistent shell family

outline._doc: edges CCW. n_deg = outward normal; keys = which keys the line must clear (all | straight | angled | id list | not:id list); bezel = gap from the furthest key pitch box; r = fillet at the END of this edge (vertex to next edge)

case._opening_frame_min: self-check: min frost frame width between outline and opening

lower_base._doc: Parametric tucked lower skirt; the separate clear 2.4mm floor follows the rounded underside datum below the weight.
lower_base._material: polished clear lower skirt over the visible stainless weight
lower_base._wall_t: Lower skirt wall3.2mm; nested plan sections use explicit tucks and preserve the bezel.
lower_base._seam_z: upper shell / lower skirt reveal datum, shared by both halves
lower_base._desk_clearance: case-frame gap for the soft rubber support pads when a desk plane callback is supplied
lower_base._bottom_front_z: fallback front underside height above local z=0 if no desk-plane callback is supplied
lower_base._graduated_curve_radius: side-section tangent blend estimate within the visual 100-180 mm range from Evo75 frames
lower_base._curve_start_fraction: start the physical circular side arc at 65 percent of half depth, leaving roughly the reference 50-75 mm rear blend run; the arc meets the rear edge at its tangent
lower_base._seam_clearance: reserved clearance only for downstream shell-fit checks; the underside loft itself follows desk_z

case._opening_sampling_guard: Extra0.35mm raster expansion compensates cell sampling and rounded pitch-box corners; measured actual opening clearance must stay>=1mm.

plan._doc: One axis-aligned rounded rectangle per half. Width/depth/center are derived from every key pitch box plus encoder/logo keepouts and the uniform bezel.
plan._bezel: Uniform plan growth outside the key, encoder and logo keepout bounding box.
plan._hub_radius_scale: Shared half-case corner radius = hub r_plan_mm times 2.0; same constant-radius family at the larger product scale.
plan._arc_segments: Fixed samples per 90 degree arc; remains 124 points at every shell/plate/PCB/loft inset.

stack._doc: Rev 2 layer z ranges in the half frame; z=0 is the local case bottom datum before pose transforms.
stack._bottom: 2.4 mm clear acrylic floor, separate from hollow lower skirt
stack._weight: 3mm stainless above floor, updated to fit low front case.
stack._battery: 4.2mm LiPo envelope beside weight, clear of PCB underside6.6.
stack._rf_module: 2mm RF module under PCB, uses plan keepout from weight.
stack._plate: 1.5mm PP11.3..12.8; plate top minus PCB top=5mm MX seat.

plate._inset: plate = case outline inset; spec wanted 4.7 but opening min dist to outline is L 4.72 / R 4.58 mm -> inset must be <=4.48; 4.4 = 0.4 mm flex gap, plate covers opening with 0.18 mm margin

pcb._inset: PCB outline remains inset from the case plan outline

flex_cut._doc: Paired through-slots adjacent to each spring support; cutter thickness crosses the 1.2 mm board.
flex_cut._slot_length: estimated flex slot length parallel to each support edge
flex_cut._slot_width: estimated PCB slot width, compatible with visible flex-cut style
flex_cut._pair_offset: normal offset from the support center to each slot center

switch._bottom: bottom housing below plate top (through the 14 mm cutout), sits on the PCB
switch._top: top housing above plate: base square, top x/y, height (cad-gates ~6.6)
switch._stem: stem cross bounding box above the top housing (x, y, h)

stab._spacing: stab stem spacing per cap width (Cherry std)
stab._housing: plate-stab housing stand-in (x, y, z above plate top)
stab._wire: wire just above the plate top, offset to the front

keycap._top_shrink: base minus top in x / y (12.7 x 14.4 top on 1u)
keycap._top_back_shift: top surface centre shifted toward the back
keycap._dish: cylindrical dish depth (cylinder axis along y)
keycap._wall: shell thickness (hollow cap, X-Ray look shows the switch)

rows._doc: h = height at top centre above the cap bottom; tilt = top normal tilted toward the user (-y); R4 = every other key
rows._macro_note: Macro column lowered one row: M1 usesR2, M2R3, M3/M4R4.

legend._margin: from the top-surface edge: x, y (top-left for alphas, bottom-left for modifiers)
legend._depth: Legacy glyph datum retained for v1 helpers; rev2 uses proud_mm and dish-conformed second-shot extrusion.
legend._style: Alphas and shifted number pairs top-left; icon modifiers/macros bottom-left; arrows centred. Custom kit-style vectors are used by rev2_keycaps.py.
legend._font_choice: Bahnschrift selected for its clean geometric sans letterforms; Segoe UI Symbol supplies modifier and navigation glyph coverage. Existing font_cap_scale() measurement remains active for size calibration.

rev2._shell_wall_mm: Clear shell wall and inside roof are offset0.8mm from the outside loft/dish; closed at the skirt rim.
rev2._body_wall_mm: Opaque white injection-moulded inner shell nominal wall thickness, retaining a hollow underside and MX socket.
rev2._body_inset_mm: White core top plan inset per side from the clear shell, exposing the transparent top/edge band.
rev2._body_base_inset_mm: White core skirt inset per side from the clear shell, exposing a continuous clear lower rim.
rev2._body_top_recess_mm: White core dished surface sits0.8mm below the outer clear dished surface.
rev2._dish_depth_mm: Cylindrical Cherry dish depth, curvature across X with cylinder axis along Y.
rev2._body_dish_depth_mm: Core uses the same0.5mm cylindrical dish curvature so the physical skin stays near-uniform in section.
rev2._top_shrink_mm: Top width and depth reductions from the key base; keeps the established 1u top size.
rev2._base_corner_mm: Rounded plan corner radius at the skirt foot.
rev2._top_corner_mm: Rounded plan corner radius at the Cherry top surface.
rev2._corner_segments: Arc subdivisions per rounded corner for a smooth rendered perimeter.
rev2._wall_profile: Normalized height, X swell and Y swell describe a restrained concave Cherry wall with a soft foot and shoulder.
rev2._top_edge_profile: Top plan scale and rim elevation inmm;0.14mm rolled edge joins wall to cylindrical dish with shared mesh vertices.
rev2._legend_proud_mm: White legend surface finishes0.04mm proud of the clear dish for a visible moulded edge/shadow.
rev2._icon_stroke_mm: Line weight for custom kit-style vector glyphs and novelty legends.
rev2._pair_base_size_mm: Primary glyph size for two-level numeric and punctuation legends.
rev2._pair_shift_size_mm: Small shifted glyph size above its primary number or punctuation mark.
rev2._pair_line_gap_mm: Clear vertical gap between measured shifted and primary glyph bounds.
rev2._modifier_size_mm: Bottom-left icon legend size for modifiers and novelty keys.
rev2._single_size_mm: Single alpha or ordinary key legend size.
rev2._shifted_legends: Exact US ANSI shifted pairs, stacked small-over-primary at the top-left of each key.
rev2._modifier_icons: Raised vector kit variants: chevron Ctrl, command-loop Win, option Alt, diamond M4, outline Shift, padlock Caps, opposing Tab arrows, Backspace/Enter arrows.
rev2._arrow_glyphs: Custom raised arrow outlines used on the navigation keys.
rev2._homing_labels: Keys that receive the X-Ray kit's raised tactile homing bar.
rev2._homing_x_mm: Homing bar centered across the key top, matching the kit's tactile front-center mark.
rev2._homing_y_mm: Homing bar sits toward the front from the dish center.
rev2._homing_width_mm: Length of the raised homing bar.
rev2._homing_depth_mm: Fore-aft width of the raised homing bar.
rev2._homing_height_mm: Height of the tactile homing bar above the dished top.
rev2._homing_radius_mm: Small edge round on the homing bar.
rev2._stem_arm_mm: Reach from MX socket center to the end of the outer cross arms.
rev2._stem_halfwidth_mm: Half-width of each outer MX socket cross arm.
rev2._socket_arm_mm: Reach of the open female cross socket cavity.
rev2._socket_halfwidth_mm: Half-width of the female MX cross socket channel.
rev2._stem_z0_mm: MX socket begins above the skirt lip underside.
rev2._socket_roof_mm: White PBT roof thickness above the socket void; socket wall height reaches the underside of each row's top.
rev2._skin_grain: Fine frosted micro-normal:8200 features/m,12micron bump,0.34 strength; roughness varies0.15-0.28 without tinting the clear resin.
rev2._icon_sizes_mm: Reference-sized strokes: circle novelty5.4 normalization, other Mnovelties4.2, Tab3.6; ordinary modifiers3.4.
rev2._skin_thickness_mm: Physical clear outer skin thickness; target0.8mm within the requested0.6-1.0mm X-Ray range.
rev2._legend_core_embed_mm: White legend columns overlap the opaque core by0.28mm before passing through the clear skin.
rev2._legend_cut_clear_skin: Closed clear shell and overlapping solid white second-shot columns: opaque white reaches0.04mm above clear surface. Render geometry avoids unstable icon Boolean cuts; manufacture tooling remains CAD work.

assumptions: R arrow shoulder includes a solid logo bay right of Up and above Right; the gull stroke stays outside the key opening.
Keycap seat height = plate top + 6.0 mm; Cherry row heights R1 9.4 / R2 7.9 / R3 7.6 / R4 8.1 mm and top tilts 8/4/0/-5 deg are approximations (no datasheet).
Switch plate holes boolean-cut; no hot-swap sockets, diodes or wiring modelled.
RF module 13 x 18 mm near the inner back corner on the PCB underside; antenna at the +y end. R position nudged -78,34 -> -74,32 to clear the cavity-inset assert.
Weight = outline inset 12mm with back edge y=10mm, thickness3mm; concept battery/RF clearances remain subject to CAD review.
Hub internals include PCB, RF module and OLED; no hub encoder or knob.
Evo75 spring count, thickness and contour are not published; leaf mount is a visible parametric concept pending mechanical validation.
